description: Implementation of FineractEntityAccessReadService for accessing entity relation data, including methods for retrieving entity access mappings, SQL query generation, and related data management within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing entity access read operations, including SQL query generation and data retrieval for entity relations.

classes.name: EntityRelationMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping entity relation data from SQL result set.

classes.name: GetOneEntityMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping a single entity-to-entity mapping record.

classes.name: EntityToEntityMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping detailed entity-to-entity mapping with entity names.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClause_WithListOfIDsForEntityAccess
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated list of entity IDs for access control based on entity type and relation.

methods.name: retrieveEntityAccessFor
methods.description: Retrieves entity access mappings for a given entity type, relation, and office hierarchy.

methods.name: getSQLForRetriveEntityAccessFor
methods.description: Constructs SQL query string for retrieving entity access data.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForLoanProductsForOffice
methods.description: Generates SQL clause for loan products access for a specific office.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForSavingsProductsForOffice
methods.description: Generates SQL clause for savings products access for a specific office.

methods.name: getSQLQueryInClauseIDList_ForChargesForOffice
methods.description: Generates SQL clause for charges access for a specific office.

methods.name: retrieveAllSupportedMappingTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all supported entity relation mapping types.

methods.name: retrieveEntityToEntityMappings
methods.description: Retrieves mappings between entities based on mapping ID and entity IDs.

methods.name: retrieveOneMapping
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity-to-entity mapping by ID.
